rubriker.title: Clutch Chess: Caruana, Nakamura, Sindarov and Pragg meet in Saint Louis
rubriker._rss_content: The Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown event returns to Saint Louis on 27–29 October, with Fabiano Caruana, Hikaru Nakamura, Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu and Javokhir Sindarov (pictured) competing in an 18-game rapid tournament. The four elite GMs will play three double round-robins, with victories worth progressively more points over the three days. A jackpot funded by drawn games further adds entertainment value to the competition. | Photo: Nils Rohde / ChessBase

rubriker.title: A farewell triumph: Capablanca wins gold in Buenos Aires 1939
rubriker._rss_content: Chess Olympiads produce remarkable stories. The 1939 Chess Olympiad in Buenos Aires was particularly dramatic, as Germany invaded Poland on 1 September 1939, while the tournament was still taking place, marking the beginning of the Second World War. Against this backdrop, it is easy to overlook the fact that José Raúl Capablanca, world champion from 1921 to 1927, played his final tournament and his final competitive game in Buenos Aires. | Photo: José Raúl Capablanca (Archive)
